candidates.title: Deterministic eta schedule and complete control-resource successor
candidates.uncertainty: Whether every BATCH-56187a blocker can be discharged in one executable-by-construction proposal without weakening the independently checked marginal estimator, matched-mean bridge, or cost boundaries.
candidates.positive_decision: Preserve a PASS-reviewed proposal and name a separately authorized future experiment-design action; this batch executes nothing.
candidates.negative_decision: Record REJECT or a scoped design obstruction with the exact failed obligation; no mathematical negative about ECDLP follows.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Record REVISE and the cheapest remaining repair or falsification control; no experiment is admitted.
candidates.next_action: Snapshot the opening, author the versioned schedule-and-storage repair, snapshot exact bytes, and obtain an independent adversarial validation.

ambiguities.question: Does exact design reconciliation or a proposal-level PASS authorize execution?

candidates.dominated_by: Pollard rho and BSGS remain the matched baselines; no Pareto improvement exists unless a later validated experiment establishes a positive gamma_s above the fully charged crossover.

sota_delta.note: Proposal and review only; no algorithmic improvement is measured or claimed.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Immutable successor proposal plus a fresh independent review-adversarial verdict bound to that snapshot.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: REVISE preserves the proposal at proposed status and names one bounded successor action.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any unfrozen eta target, threshold, seed, treatment/control operation, traffic event, retained record, byte, unequal fixture, reserve, or preservation of the existing claim ceiling is REVISE rather than inferred PASS.
peripheral_exclusions: Any hypothesis or research-question status change
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: The independent review and Coordinator disposition are ledger-archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Native Idea Generator and independent Validator inference time; no curve computation.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: Design work is bounded by deterministic statistical schedules and integer operation/byte reconciliation, not by ECDLP instance size.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One active candidate and one role at a time; archival tasks run alone.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one proposal, one independent verdict, and one ledger disposition, or immediately on an archive-integrity failure.
